description: Breastfeeding and returning to the workplace
whatThisIs: Breastfeeding and Returning to Work is a resource page that explains state and federal laws on the rights of breastfeeding employees returning to work. The website also offers resources to help breastfeeding families find local support, provides information about state and federal laws on breastfeeding in the workplace, and describes the coalition's mission of breastfeeding advocacy and education.
whoItHelps: People and families looking for an overview of state and federal laws for returning employees
People looking for more information about what returning to work while breastfeeding might look like
People interested in learning more about breastfeeding advocacy in Massachusetts
whatToKnow: The Massachusetts Breastfeeding Coalition was founded in 1999 as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. The website serves as a resource and a point of contact for the coalition and its work with community partners.
name: Breastfeeding and Returning to Work
